meta.title: List your venue on Ritme | Ritme for business
meta.description: Run a mother-and-baby class, pool, play house or workshop? Build your venue page on Ritme so nearby mothers find you and send booking requests.

hero.title: Introduce your venue to the mothers in your city
hero.body: If you run a mother-and-baby class, a pool, a play house or a parenting workshop, build your venue page on Ritme. Mothers nearby find you on the map and send booking requests right from there.
hero.pill1: On the map and in search
hero.panelTitle: Your venue, in front of nearby mothers
hero.panelBody: A page with photos, services, prices and opening hours; it goes live after the Ritme team reviews it.

reach.title: Be seen by mothers nearby
reach.body: Venues are shown to the right mothers by distance and their child's age; not by how much you pay.

book.title: Booking requests, reminders and cancellations
book.body: Share your free times. Online bookings are requests that the Ritme team confirms; reminders and cancellations are handled for you.

reviews.title: Reviews from real customers only
reviews.body: Only people who booked through Ritme can leave a review, and you can reply to each one.

s1.title: Introduce your venue
s1.body: Name, type of service, city and how to reach you

s2.title: Location and photos
s2.body: A pin on the map, real photos of the space, age ranges and opening hours

s3.title: Services and prices
s3.body: Classes, duration, capacity, price and how booking works

s4.title: Documents and review
s4.body: Your licence and the instructors' certificates; your page goes live after review

req.title: What you need
req.license: A business or activity licence from the relevant authority
req.coach: Coaching or first-aid certificates of your instructors
req.health: A health certificate for pools and water areas
req.photos: At least 4 real photos of the space, without children's faces

terms.title: Terms of cooperation
terms.body: The commission or subscription model has not been set yet. The Ritme team will share the terms with you before your page goes live.
terms.note: Document review is not a medical endorsement of the services; it only means the venue holds an activity licence and its details match reality.

time.a: The form takes about 15 minutes. The Ritme team tells you how long the document review takes once they receive your application.

rank.q: Can I buy a higher spot in the results?
rank.a: No. Results are ordered only by distance, the child's age and mothers' reviews, and there are no paid placements.

phone.q: What if I do not want online booking?
phone.a: Choose "phone calls only" and the venue's number is shown instead of a booking button.

privacy.q: What information about mothers reaches me?
privacy.a: Only the name, the child's name and age, and a contact number. No health data ever goes from Ritme to a venue.

cta.title: Ready?
cta.body: Send your application; a Ritme specialist will call you to complete the details.

join.title: List your venue
join.autosave: Your draft is saved automatically; come back and continue whenever you like.
join.previewNote: Rating and distance appear after publishing and the first bookings.
join.loginTitle: Log in to list your venue
join.loginBody: The draft is tied to your account so you can come back and continue whenever you like.
join.loadError: The application could not be loaded.
join.locked: The application is under review and can no longer be edited.
join.needsInfo: The Ritme team needs more information.
